Critical UI composition: middle 60% of upper 32% must be uninterrupted plain blue painted wall (portrait: middle 56% upper 30%). No window, rail, lamp, curtain, plants or ornament intrudes there. Window and all central furnishing start BELOW that clear wall. Sleeping golden dog prominently visible in middle band y=.45–.72, softly lit and anatomically natural. Bottom area a cozy patterned rug for results overlay. Preserve the original reference's warmth, intricate natural brush-painted detail and glowing wood, avoid empty flat minimalism.
